description.narrative: The first meeting between DSU and Siasa Place was in November 2023. In August 2023 we visited Siasa Place as a part of a Partner Identification, where we investigated the opportunities for a potential partnership. After the visit we decided to continue with a Preparatory study. During the preparatory study we want to learn more about the context of a given project, see how our organizations could work together on a specific project and begin to work on the application for a pilot project. All of this will assist with laying the cornerstones for a future project collaboration. The specific project we wish to initiate will seek to provide youth with different tools to participate in the democratic conversation and political spaces. The project will focus on three main themes: tech and politics, women in politics, and local change.
